description_en: Pre-pushes the business or service data of an application to a file server
description_zh: 调用PushApplicationData预推应用的业务/服务类数据到文件服务器
name: PushApplicationData

parameters.help_en: The list of data files to be pre-pushed, in the string format of a JSON array
parameters.help_zh: 预推的数据文件列表，Json数组的字符串格式
parameters.name: data

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

Before calling this operation, activate the Edge Application Hosting service and create an application by calling CreateApplication. Obtain the AppId from the response of the CreateApplication operation
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

调用前需开通边缘应用托管服务，并通过 CreateApplication 创建应用；AppId 从创建应用的返回值中获取
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The canary pre-push policy in JSON string format. Multiple distribution policies are supported. By default, all data is pre-pushed
parameters.help_zh: 灰度预推策略，Json格式的字符串，支持多种分发策略，默认全量预推
parameters.name: push_strategy

PushResult.description_en: The execution results of the pre-push operations for each data file
PushResult.description_zh: 各个数据文件的预推操作执行结果

items.description_en: The execution result of the pre-push operation for a data file
items.description_zh: 数据文件的预推操作执行结果

Name.description_en: The name of the data file

ResultCode.description_en:
The pre-push error code. Valid values:
0: The pre-push operation succeeded.
100: The pre-push operation was already executed, and the current pre-push status is Pre-push Successful.
200: The pre-push operation was already executed, and the current pre-push status is Pre-pushing (some file servers are in the pre-pushing state).
300: The pre-push operation failed and must be triggered again. For the specific error description, refer to ResultDescrip
ResultCode.description_zh:
预推错误码。枚举类型，取值范围：

0：预推操作成功
100：已执行过预推操作，且当前预推状态处于"已预推成功"
200：已执行过预推操作，且当前预推状态处于"预推中"（部分文件服务器处于预推中）
300：预推操作失败，需要重新触发预推操作；具体错误描述参考ResultDescrip

ResultDescrip.description_en: The description of the status result

Version.description_en: The version number of the data file
